description: This file is a shell script primarily used for testing the git fetch-pack functionality, including various scenarios such as shallow clones, protocol versions, ref fetching, and object filtering. It contains test setup functions, test cases, and auxiliary functions for simulating git operations within a testing environment.

methods.name: test_negotiation_algorithm_default
methods.description: Function to test negotiation algorithm behavior using protocol version 0 and 2, verifying the 'have' lines sent during fetch based on the protocol version and repository setup.

methods.name: fetch_filter_blob_limit_zero
methods.description: Function that tests the behavior of fetching with object filtering when the limit is set to zero, ensuring blobs are not fetched but commits are.
